title: Greek Tiropita
description: Traditional Greek cheese pie, flaky phyllo, and creamy cheese filling.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
Cut phyllo sheets in half lengthwise.
In a bowl, mix together crumbled cheese, chopped parsley, salt, and pepper.
Place a phyllo sheet on a flat surface, brush with melted butter, and sprinkle with cheese mixture.
Brush top phyllo layer with egg wash.
Cut tiropita into diamond or square shapes.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
